description: BANXE Platform — Frontend Metrics (Core Web Vitals + errors) | IL-UI-01

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(ts) AS time, avg(value) AS lcp_ms FROM banxe.web_vitals WHERE metric='LCP' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT count() AS errors FROM banxe.frontend_errors WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
SELECT endpoint, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS p95 FROM banxe.browser_api_calls WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY p95 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS active FROM banxe.web_sessions WHERE last_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
SELECT route, count() AS views, countIf(is_error=1) AS errors FROM banxe.page_views WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR GROUP BY route ORDER BY views DESC

title: BANXE Frontend Metrics
